Summary

Updates suggested models for Gemini, OpenAI, cloud Claude, OpenRouter, AiHubMix, and ZenMux channels. - Gemini channel presets now suggest newer model names. - Direct provider presets now suggest newer OpenAI and Anthropic models. - Aggregator presets now suggest updated models across providers. Reviews (2) · Last reviewed commit: ["fix(frontend): use gemini-3.8-flash for ..."](https://github.com/looplj/axonhub/commit/f2568c80f57da0c55e32f74532175fa34e86737c) · [Reviewed by Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=greptile_review&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=review_public&utm_content=looplj/axonhub)
please help to update all channels, thanks

Pushed a follow-up commit covering the remaining channels. Besides the Gemini and OpenAI channels from before, these now default to current models: `anthropic_aws` / `anthropic_gcp` (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 IDs), `zenmux`, `zenmux_responses` and `zenmux_anthropic` (`openai/gpt-5.6-sol`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`), `openrouter` (`anthropic/claude-opus-5.5`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`; the unlisted `moonshotai/kimi-k2:free` is dropped) and `aihubmix` / `aihubmix_anthropic` (`claude-sonnet-5-5`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `deepseek-v3.2`, `kimi-k2.6`). The OpenRouter, ZenMux and AiHubMix IDs were checked against each gateway's `/models` list, and the Bedrock and Vertex IDs against Anthropic's models page. The test now covers all of them.

Not changed: the `*_fake` channels, `github` (its models catalog endpoint returned nothing usable, so replacement IDs could not be confirmed and its list stays as it was, including older entries like `openai/gpt-4o`), and the other gateways, where no retired entries were confirmed.
